instruction: I want to configure Thunderbird to receive emails from work-email@corporate.com, but only display them during working hours (9 AM - 5 PM) and automatically hide them outside of work hours using built-in scheduling features.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird does not have built-in time-based visibility scheduling or automatic hiding features for emails. While filters can organize emails, there is no native functionality to conditionally display or hide messages based on time of day without extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - Thunderbird lacks built-in time-based email visibility scheduling features
Appropriate use of 'infeasible' evaluator function for a task that cannot be accomplished with native software capabilities
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible (no native time-based filtering/hiding functionality)
Evaluator semantically correct: does not attempt to verify functionality that doesn't exist
